_readme: Twin Thrones music, wave 1: 6 slots x 2 versions (a and b), no vocals. Drop the files as games/twin-thrones/music/<slot>-a.mp3 and <slot>-b.mp3 (slots: menu, age1, age2, age3, victory, defeat) and run build.py: games with files present are wired by src/sound.js through gameaudio.js + gx-music.js; no code change.

menu.prompt: Instrumental title music for a two-player card-drafting duel set in rival ancient cities: warm plucked lyre and frame drum, soft low strings pad, calm but expectant, 84 BPM, 3/4 feel, 16-bar loop that ends on a whole bar so it loops cleanly, no vocals, no spoken words, mixed for a phone game. Make 2 versions (a and b).

age1.prompt: Instrumental game music for the first age of a card duel: light hopeful bronze-age feel, hand drums, wooden flute melody, simple plucked bass, gently building, 92 BPM, 4/4, 4-bar intro then 16-bar loop that ends on a whole bar so it loops cleanly, no vocals, no spoken words, mixed for a phone game. Make 2 versions (a and b).

age2.prompt: Instrumental game music for the second age of a card duel: busier and more confident, hand drums plus a plucked oud riff, bowed strings answer the flute, a sense of cities growing and rivalry, 100 BPM, 4/4, 4-bar intro then 16-bar loop that ends on a whole bar so it loops cleanly, no vocals, no spoken words, mixed for a phone game. Make 2 versions (a and b).

age3.prompt: Instrumental game music for the final age of a card duel: tense and grand, low war drums, brass swells, driving string ostinato, the pawn is near the edge and every pick counts, 108 BPM, 4/4, 4-bar intro then 16-bar loop that ends on a whole bar so it loops cleanly, no vocals, no spoken words, mixed for a phone game. Make 2 versions (a and b).

victory.prompt: Short instrumental victory fanfare for a card duel: bright brass and bells rising to a held major chord, triumphant and warm, about 12 seconds, plays once and ends cleanly, no vocals, no spoken words, mixed for a phone game. Make 2 versions (a and b).

defeat.prompt: Short instrumental defeat piece for a card duel: slow low strings and a single lyre, bittersweet and dignified not comic, about 12 seconds, plays once and fades to silence, no vocals, no spoken words, mixed for a phone game. Make 2 versions (a and b).
